summary: 1963 Aermotor MC-39 tower on Alabama Highway 59 south of Stapleton, Baldwin County, administered by the Alabama Forestry Commission; NHLR-registered 2009.

facts.design: 100-foot Aermotor MC-39 tower that replaced a 91-foot creosote lookout

Registered December 12, 2009 as US 851, AL 29 (the blog gives AL 30)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register gives AL 29 and the blog gives AL 30 for the same US 851 number. The story reports the Register figure and mentions the blog.

notes_for_editor: No staffing, fire history, access or current-condition information in any source read. A Baldwin County history Facebook post on 1941 fire towers returned no readable text, so it is not cited. The blog's AL 30 disagrees with the Register's AL 29. Brief elevation 61.6 m matches the Register's 202 ft (62 m) and the OSM ele tag of 62, so no change is proposed. No new photos.
